title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reading.body:
This incident shows a generative AI system being used to create a false bomb threat delivered by phone. The failure is not a model error but a deceptive use of the technology: a caller produced an AI-generated threatening message and masked the phone number to conceal their identity. The deployment context is an emergency response process where a school receives a call and must decide whether to lock down.

The failure mode is impersonation through synthetic media, not a factual assertion by an AI in normal use. Catching it before a lockdown would have required verifying the caller's identity or detecting that the voice was AI-generated, but the masked number made that difficult. It is not established who made the calls, and no arrests have been made.

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia, received its fourth artificial intelligence-generated bomb threat during the current school year on Monday. School officials implemented a lockdown as a precautionary measure, though the school eventually resumed normal operations. The threats have followed a similar pattern, using masked phone numbers to conceal the caller's identity.

Local school police have partnered with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the Federal Bureau of Investigation to identify who is responsible for the threats. So far, authorities have not made any arrests or publicly identified a suspect. Officials sent a letter to parents notifying them of the incident and the ongoing investigation.
